Geisamahi reads through the Geisamahi entry of the race compendium, within Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, marked by Iskareth. Small Ferretfolk Tinkerers, Scouts, and Clever Problem-Solvers. Table cues: ancestral instincts, homeland pressure, and local reputation; starting tendency Altruistic - Chaotic - Cooperative - Honorable.
publicRumors: Vadim's best liquor is legal; his best plans usually are not.
He once staged a fake kidnapping to help a radio host find a spine and still insists it was character development.

npcRoster.name: Mai Atomwake
npcRoster.publicDescription: Mai Atomwake is a Drow ritual chemist who turns faith, chemistry, and survival horror into bottles people are desperate enough to drink. At the Sylvarielle Market Hall, she brews anti-fog tonics, ichor-laced protections, purification mixtures, and devotional compounds for the Choral Synod, always insisting that controlled contamination is better than ignorant exposure. She is sincere, unsettling, and scientifically useful, which is exactly why her work should never be left unsupervised.
npcRoster.settlementAncestryTexture: Sylvarielle is a Village in Aelvanyr, under Participatory Democracy, with low danger, Farming, Partial forest, Deep forest terrain, and public routes by Caravan, Train. Local records favor Altruistic, Lawful, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Halfling — Stout Halfling, Kender, Kithkin. Drow reads through the Half-Elf (choose an Elf Bloodline) entry of the race compendium, within Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, marked by Nebyrr. The local form is read through Half-Elf — Drow (Underdark). Half-elves are dual-natured beings born of human and elven lineage, often balancing ambition with longevity. They tend to struggle with identity but excel at diplomacy, adaptability, and bridging cultures. Table cues: +2 Charisma, +1 to Two Other Ability Scores, Darkvision, Fey Ancestry; starting tendency Neutral - Lawful - Cooperative - Neutral.
publicRumors: Mai Atomwake knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Marduday.

areaModel.method: Earth-sized spherical Voronoi province territory model
areaModel.reason: The province JSON files contain locked province center latitude/longitude coordinates, but no hand-drawn province border polygons. This model assigns every point on Belavadös to the nearest province center on an Earth-sized sphere, producing non-overlapping province territories whose areas sum exactly to the full planetary surface area in this model.
areaModel.boundaryNote: Boundary vertices are generated model borders between province centers, not hand-surveyed coastline or political-border artwork.
areaModel.precisionNote: Areas are model-exact for the spherical Voronoi territory model and rounded to 6 decimal places in output.
